note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; relationships are drawn only as supplied (plain relations by default) and carry no legal meaning, validity or outcome.
coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule 2026-09-26 (AUTHORING item 20): after the fallbacks (adaptive room size, captions above/below/beside in three widths, relation labels along and off each connector in two widths, legend in its own column), two stress items are capped for 1:1. Measured with six participants (three at the tables): the room labels could not be placed clear of each other at 17.1 px in 1:1 (fallback overlaps); with five participants (the baseline count) they fit. The bench–windows relation label 'linked to the windows (as supplied)' (35 chars) found no clear place at >= 16 px in 1:1; 'linked (as supplied) to both' (28 chars, longer than the baseline's 20) fits. Every other stress field keeps its full length. A fourth stress relation (building–bench) was dropped: in every ratio its connector had to cross the room component (ambiguous routing, AUTHORING item 16); the stress keeps the baseline's three relations with longer labels.
